tools.name: wasi_search_properties
tools.description: List properties (listings) in the Wasi account, with optional filters for sale, rent, transfer, type, location, price and bedrooms. Wasi API: GET /v1/property/search.

tools.name: wasi_get_property
tools.description: Get one property with its full detail (price, location, features, images). Wasi API: GET /v1/property/get/{id}.

tools.name: wasi_list_property_clients
tools.description: List the clients linked to one property, with their relation type. Wasi API: GET /v1/property/clients/{id}.

tools.name: wasi_list_property_documents
tools.description: List the documents attached to one property, grouped by category. Wasi API: GET /v1/property/{id}/documents/all.

tools.name: wasi_list_property_types
tools.description: List the property types the account can use (house, apartment, shop, and custom types). Wasi API: GET /v1/property-type/all.

tools.name: wasi_search_clients
tools.description: List the clients (contacts and leads) in the Wasi account. Wasi API: GET /v1/client/search.

tools.name: wasi_get_client
tools.description: Get one client's contact details, status, origin and type. Wasi API: GET /v1/client/get/{id}.

tools.name: wasi_list_client_properties
tools.description: List the properties linked to one client, with the client's relation to each. Wasi API: GET /v1/client/properties/{id}.

tools.name: wasi_list_client_types
tools.description: List the client types (for example buyer, owner, seeking) that the account can assign. Wasi API: GET /v1/client-type/all.

tools.name: wasi_list_tasks
tools.description: List agenda tasks (calls, meetings, follow-ups) assigned between two dates. Both dates are required. Wasi API: GET /v1/management/tasks.

tools.name: wasi_get_task
tools.description: Get one agenda task by its id and assigned date. Wasi API: GET /v1/management/get/{id}?date=.

tools.name: wasi_list_users
tools.description: List the users (agents and administrators) of the Wasi account. Use their ids for assignments. Wasi API: GET /v1/user/all-users.

tools.name: wasi_create_client
tools.description: Create a client (contact or lead) in the Wasi account. Pass the Wasi field names in fields, for example first_name, last_name, email, phone, id_client_type. Wasi API: POST /v1/client/add.

tools.name: wasi_update_client
tools.description: Update fields of one client. Send only the fields to change. Wasi API: POST /v1/client/update/{id}.

tools.name: wasi_link_client_to_property
tools.description: Link a client to a property with a relation type (for example owner or buyer). Wasi API: POST /v1/client/{id_client}/add-property/{id_property}?id_client_type=.

tools.name: wasi_update_property
tools.description: Update fields of one property (price, status, agent, description). Send only the fields to change. Wasi API: POST /v1/property/update/{id}.

tools.name: wasi_create_task
tools.description: Create an agenda task (call, meeting, follow-up) for a user and optionally a client. Pass the Wasi field names in fields, for example subject, description, date, management_type_id, id_user, id_client. Wasi API: POST /v1/management/add.

tools.name: wasi_update_task
tools.description: Update fields of one agenda task. The task's assigned date is required to find it. Wasi API: POST /v1/management/update/{id}?date=.

tools.name: wasi_delete_task
tools.description: Delete one agenda task. This cannot be undone from the MCP server. Wasi API: POST /v1/management/delete/{id}?date=.
